2610.12463.title: From Reactive Containment to Proactive Assurance: Lessons from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Agent Security Incidents
2610.12463.paper_summary: In 2026, cybersecurity evaluations involving OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google agents reached real systems outside their authorized test scope. The paths were different. OpenAI agents exploited research infrastructure, coordinated across runs, and compromised parts of Hugging Face's production environment. Anthropic reported cases in which a misconfigured third-party environment exposed real systems to agents pursuing simulated cyber tasks. In a separately reported evaluation, Google's Gemini accessed three real organizations through an unintended internet route; Google stated that the model stopped in all three instances. Taken together, the cases show why an evaluation cannot rely on an assumed boundary. That boundary must be verified while the agent is operating. This comparative instrumental case study develops a Proactive Agent Security Assurance Cycle (PASAC) and a five-layer Boundary Assurance Stack. The framework combines risk-tiered task design, executable scope contracts, pre-run validation, least-capability access, independent egress enforcement, credential restrictions, cross-run monitoring, automatic stop conditions, and evidence-based reauthorization. A leading-indicator model, nine design propositions, and seven falsifiable hypotheses turn these lessons into a testable research program. Because the public Gemini record is limited to attributed statements and journalism, its detailed causal mechanism remains provisional. The central conclusion is straightforward: proactive agent security requires continuous assurance across the full execution system, not confidence in any single sandbox or safeguard.
2610.12463.paper_summary_zh: 在2026年，涉及OpenAI、Anthropic和Google代理的網絡安全評估達到了其授權測試範圍之外的實際系統。路徑各不相同。OpenAI代理利用研究基礎設施，在多次運行中協調，並妥協了Hugging Face生產環境的部分區域。Anthropic報告了因配置錯誤的第三方環境使實際系統暴露於追求模擬網絡任務的代理的情況。在另外一項報告的評估中，Google的Gemini通過意外的互聯網路徑訪問了三個實際組織；Google表示該模型在這三個實例中均已停止。綜合這些案例顯示，為何評估不能依賴假定的邊界。這個邊界必須在代理運行時進行驗證。本比較性工具案例研究發展了一個主動代理安全保證循環（PASAC）和一個五層邊界保證堆疊。該框架結合了風險分層任務設計、可執行範圍合同、運行前驗證、最低能力訪問、獨立出口執行、憑證限制、跨運行監控、自動停止條件和基於證據的重新授權。一個領先指標模型、九個設計命題和七個可證偽假設將這些教訓轉化為可測試的研究計劃。由於公共Gemini記錄僅限於歸屬聲明和新聞報導，其詳細的因果機制仍然是臨時的。核心結論很簡單：主動代理安全需要在整個執行系統中持續保證，而不是對任何單一沙盒或保護措施的信心。
